title: David B NDE 31
content: I was at an all-time low in my life in all areas: Broke from gambling addiction, wife left four months pregnant with my son, a lot of financial problems, bad family relations all around. My wife came this day in June 1996 while I was at work, took my car, cleaned out the apartment, and was back at her parent's house by the time I got off work. I had no desire to live anymore. I took every household drug or chemical I could get my hands on, said a prayer, and went to sleep. I awoke from sleep with my body convulsing; it was cold, and numb. I couldn't feel my extremities. I said to myself, 'Here it goes, I'm dying.' I then saw in my mind's eye a scene of space with stars and a galaxy rotating clockwise. I started approaching the center of the galaxy by flying with my hands in front of me, the stars started to progressively fly past me faster and faster like out of Star Trek. I was flying straight and the galaxy was rotating, then suddenly my relativity changed or something. I couldn't tell if I was rotating clockwise or if it was the galaxy that was rotating. As I got closer to the center, the stars started flying by really fast, so that it looked like almost a constant light. At this point, my consciousness moved back to my body and I was looking at myself from the right side of my body, as if I was lying there next to myself. I then started to feel my spirit start to raise out of my body. I started floating. As this happened, I all of a sudden got scared, I didn't want to die. At that moment, I saw future events that I was going to miss pass quickly before my eyes. I felt a sense of regret, and fear. I cried to God and asked if he would let me live. At that moment, I felt my spirit sink back into my body and attach just above my navel. I was amazed that my spirit attached at that part of my body. I then had this gut feeling that I wasn't going to die and this peace overcame me. My mind's eye then went back to the view of the galaxy but only in reverse. The galaxy was rotating counterclockwise and the stars were distant. I woke up many hours later and threw up the chemicals in my body (Blue). I had lost vision in my right eye, my head had a deafening alarm going off in it, and I had no balance. A friend found called an ambulance. I went to the hospital, had my stomach pumped, regained my vision, was in intensive care for a day, and was forced to go to a psychiatric ward for three days.

out_of_body.vantage_other_detail: Looking at himself from the right side of his body, "as if I was lying there next to myself."
out_of_body.separation_sensations_other: Felt his spirit start to raise out of his body; started floating; became scared and did not want to die.

tunnel.passage_other_detail: A scene of outer space with stars and a rotating galaxy; he flew toward the galaxy center; later the view reversed as he returned.
tunnel.movement_other_detail: Stars progressively flew past faster and faster, like "out of Star Trek"; relativity changed such that he could not tell if he or the galaxy was rotating.

environment.environment_other_detail: Space scene with stars and a galaxy rotating; stars became "almost a constant light" as he approached the center.

boundary_and_return.return_reason_other_detail: He became scared, did not want to die, and asked God to let him live after seeing future events he would miss.
boundary_and_return.return_method_other_detail: Felt his spirit sink back into his body and attach just above his navel; then the galaxy view reversed.

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Initial space/galaxy flight; then OBE beside body; fear and regret; prayer to God; spirit sank back into body; galaxy view reversed.
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: Transitional space/galaxy imagery occurred before and after the OBE/return; no tunnel/light/life review/being encounters were described.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Space/galaxy travel imagery with changing relativity; spirit reattachment sensation localized "just above my navel."
unique_elements.notable_quotes: "Here it goes, I'm dying."; "out of Star Trek"; "I was looking at myself from the right side of my body"; "I felt my spirit sink back into my body and attach just above my navel."
